explain.title: How this works.

body.rep: You raise the request; the coordinator builds the real quotation in SMAC and gets it signed, then accepts it here and sends you the PDF. When the customer pays, you confirm the payment. The coordinator approves what actually leaves the warehouse.
body.coordinator: The rep raises the request; you build the real quotation in SMAC and get it signed, then accept it here and send the PDF back. The rep confirms the payment. You approve what actually leaves the warehouse, and record how the customer is paying for it.
